summary: Psyence Biomedical Ltd. filed a Form 6-K on April 20, 2026, disclosing Amendment No. 3 to its existing Common Stock Purchase Agreement with White Lion Capital, LLC. The amendment introduces an intraday purchase mechanism allowing Psyence to require White Lion to buy up to 5% of average daily trading volume at the lowest price in the hour after acceptance, settling in two business days. White Lion receives a $22,000 document fee. This is a routine equity line financing amendment, not a special situation event.
